B.13/S.O.2.                                                                 7th June, 1941.

Dear Whetmore,

I attach a report received from Pilkington in connection with an intercepted letter from RETZLAW.

I should be glad to receive your views for transmission to Pilkington in due course.

Yours sincerely,

G.H. Langdon, Major,
for Lt.-Col. W.E. Hinchley Cooke
